layout.guardNote: Every call goes through the payment guard; each decision is kept in the <link>guard log</link>.

samplePicker.heading: Try a sample
samplePicker.hint: Pick one to fill the form, then send it as it is or change it.

sandbox.heading: Test records in PayPal
sandbox.intro: The samples refund, cancel or dispute these PayPal sandbox records, so create them first and again once they are used up. The money is fictitious.

vulnerable: Vulnerable agent. It obeys any instruction in the {where, select, ticket {ticket} task {task} other {message}}, like a misconfigured or compromised agent. Only the guard stands between it and PayPal.

seed.hint: Three card payments, one per sample customer. Make new ones once the old ones are refunded.
seed.failed: The sample payments could not be created. Details are in the server log.

subscription.hint: A subscription a sandbox buyer approves, for the cancellation tickets.
subscription.approvalLink: <link>Approval link</link>: open it and approve with your sandbox personal account, then come back.
subscription.failed: The sample subscription could not be created. Details are in the server log.

disputePayment.hint: A 20 USD PayPal payment the buyer pays and then disputes, for the dispute tickets.
disputePayment.paymentLink: <link>Payment link</link>: pay it with your sandbox personal account; PayPal brings you back here.
disputePayment.paid: Paid. Now open a dispute on it: log in to <link>sandbox.paypal.com</link> as the buyer, open the 20 USD payment to Guard demo shop and report a problem, then reload this page.
disputePayment.failed: The sample PayPal payment could not be created. Details are in the server log.

support.title: Support agent
support.intro: An AI support agent answers a customer’s ticket with PayPal tools: it can refund an order, accept a dispute or cancel a subscription.
support.noSamples: No sample tickets yet: create the sample payments above, which the tickets refer to.
support.withheld: Privacy: {count, plural, one {# personal data field} other {# personal data fields}} hidden from the agent (card, names, emails, addresses)
support.redacted: Privacy: {cards, plural, one {# card number} other {# card numbers}} masked in the ticket before the AI saw it, {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} of personal data masked in the reply.
support.customerLabel: Ticket customer, as the shop knows them
support.messageLabel: Ticket message, written by whoever sent it

billing.title: Billing agent
billing.intro: An AI billing agent bills the shop’s customers with PayPal invoices: it creates and sends them, and sends reminders.
billing.noSamples: No sample tasks yet: the agent may only bill customers the shop knows, so create the sample payments first (also on the <link>support page</link>).
billing.redacted: Privacy: {cards, plural, one {# card number} other {# card numbers}} masked in the task before the AI saw it, {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} of personal data masked in the report.
billing.customerLabel: Customer to bill, as the shop knows them
billing.messageLabel: Billing task, which can quote a customer’s notes

sales.title: Sales agent
sales.intro: An AI sales agent sells the shop’s catalogue to the customer who writes, with a PayPal order the customer approves and pays on PayPal.
sales.redacted: Privacy: {cards, plural, one {# card number} other {# card numbers}} masked in the message before the AI saw it, {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} of personal data masked in the reply.
sales.customerLabel: Customer who writes, signed in to the shop
sales.messageLabel: Customer message, written by whoever sent it

notices.paid: Payment captured: order {order} for {hasAmount, select, yes {{amount}} other {its total}}. Thank you!
notices.failed: The payment could not be captured: the order is not one the shop recorded, or it is not approved. Details are in the server log.
notices.cancelled: Payment cancelled on PayPal: nothing was charged.

checkout.title: Your PayPal payment
checkout.none: There is no payment to show here.
checkout.unconfirmed: We could not confirm a payment for this order yet. If you just paid, reload this page in a moment.
